From the equation,
\[
b(3-c)=21c+12 \quad\Rightarrow\quad b=\frac{21c+12}{3-c}.
\]
Since \(c/6\) is a probability, \(0\le c\le 6\), and \(c\) is an integer. Also \(b\) must be an integer with \(b-4>0\), so \(b>4\).

Testing integer \(c=0,1,2,3,4,5,6\), only \(c=2\) gives a valid integer \(b>4\):
\[
c=2 \Rightarrow b=\frac{42+12}{1}=54.
\]
Thus \(c=2\).
